blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) will issue a subpoena against comedian Mr. JP Aguilera of Pencilbox Comedy over his “sexual” playground post involving children. NBI Director Melvin Matibag said this after Council for the Welfare of Children (CWC) Executive Director Angelo Tapales, accompanied by House Committee on the Welfare of Children Vice Chairperson Ann Matibag, arrived at the NBI headquarters to seek an investigation into Aguilera’s controversial post. Aguilera posted on Facebook: “Sabi ng doktor ko watch what you eat, kaso kumokonti na yung mga playground.” (My doctor said to watch what you eat, but playgrounds are […]...
